challenge.better_approach: Considered: have the land script (akienasus's scratchpad land_one.sh) run recompile_gate.sh. That is a scratch script, not a component, and every other box's merge would still drift. A post-merge hook is the event git already fires, at the compiler's own address — matching the gate's 'the writer pokes the door, no poller' design.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That merges are the drift's event. A pull --rebase does not fire post-merge (it fires post-rewrite), so a box that rebases onto a landed charter change still drifts until /intent's read-refresh. Also: the recompile writes the lab into the commons tree, which the lander then commits — the hook writes, it does not commit.
challenge.prior_art: Grepped CairnCommons tickets, ideas and questions for recompile_gate, congruency-lab, post-merge: 40e40e8e5d53 covers skills poking the gate of their own checkout; 90f2 is verify_lab; 6fb272ba3d64 is the reseal that the drift cost. No ticket covers a merge. The tester's pre-commit (cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-commit, install_hook in reseal.py) is the pattern for a tracked hook installed into .git/hooks.
challenge.real_collision: 'intentions-congruency-lab is derived, never authored' — no collision: recompile_gate.sh is the lab's legitimate derived writer, and the hook only pokes it. The gate's charter says 'invoked by EVENTS only'; a merge is an event, so this is a distinction recorded, not a collision.

answers.falsifier: Done when: a merge that changes a charter leaves the lab copy byte-equal to its source, and a merge that changes no lab source leaves the lab untouched. Wrong intent if lab drift after merges is measured to come from somewhere other than merges (e.g. rebase pulls), so the hook would fire on the wrong event.
answers.how: A post-merge hook beside the compiler (cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/hooks/post-merge) reads the names ORIG_HEAD..HEAD changed and pokes recompile_gate.sh when any is a lab source; recompile_gate.sh gains an install mode that lays the hook into a repo's hooks dir. Red-first proof merges a charter change in a scratch repo pair and reads the lab copy.
answers.shape: aside — to the intentions_model_compiler's write gate (recompile_gate.sh), whose charter already names its events as the writers that poke it
answers.traces_to: Law 1 (the model consult must read a current model, not re-derive it) and Law 9 (a lab drifted by a merge reads red in test_verify_on_the_real_repo with nothing wrong in the code — measured: 6fb2 lost a walk to it).
answers.what: A git merge into cairn or CairnCommons that changes a lab source (a beside-code charter or an intentions-not-beside-code entry) pokes recompile_gate.sh, so intentions-congruency-lab matches its sources the moment the merge lands.
